title: Free Bullet Impact VFX for Godot 4

globals.Muzzlux.wind: Vector3, m/s. The cloud a hit throws off drifts with it.
globals.Muzzlux.impact_parent: where Muzzlux.impact() parents a fire-and-forget hit
globals.Muzzlux.impact_scene: use one scene for every surface instead of a preset per surface

surfaces.cloud: a grey-white cone of powder that hangs

nodes_3d.what: the material-specific impact for concrete, metal and wood

not_in_lite: No muzzle flash and no tracer. Lite is the hit side only.
Shots leave nothing behind: no bullet holes, no shell casings, no gun smoke.
3 surfaces of 9, and no automatic surface detection - you pass the string yourself.
One set of colours. max_concurrent is capped at 4, so sustained fire drops hits.
No energy weapons, no flashbang, no smoke grenade, no blood option, no 2D.
gotchas: Lite has no surface table, so pass the surface id yourself: &"concrete", &"metal" or &"wood". An id Lite does not know draws the concrete hit.
max_concurrent is capped at 4 in Lite. The full pack ships 16 and allows 32.
Upgrading is a folder copy: drop the full pack's addons/muzzlux_fx over this one. Every export here exists there with the same default.
The pack ships no audio of any kind.

presets.name: impact_concrete

presets.name: impact_metal

presets.what: Long splinters that spin end over end, a tan puff.
